title: Integration Healthboard + Triage Brief — 2027-08-12
content:
Meeting: Solutions Engineering + Professional Services — Integration Healthboard & Triage
Date: 2027-08-12
Facilitator: Mariana Lopez
Duration: 45m (standup style, triage after)
Attendees: Mariana Lopez, Ethan Kim, Priya Shah, Darren Wu, Lea Martin, Toni Alvarez (SRE - partial), Michael O. (Customer Success - notes)

Agenda:
- Quick health scoreboard (top customer integrations)
- Open blockers and escalations (SLA-impacting)
- Rollout windows / cutover risks this week
- Action items and owners
- Notes to follow / asynchronous followups

---

1) Healthboard snapshot (quick bullets)
- Alder (Tier 1) — Amber: steady traffic, occasional 500s from region-eu-west during peak 11:30-13:00 UTC. Rate-limiting config mismatch suspected (per PROSERV-212).
- Mercury (Sandbox → Prod scheduled) — Red: DB schema migration failed in canary; rollback done. No customer data lost, but cutover delayed 48–72h. Impact: enterprise beta launch postponed.
- Starlight (ongoing POC) — Green: latency & cost metrics within expectations; moved to 3rd-party auth staging; final sign-off pending security review.
- Arbour (Dedicated customer) — Amber: observed degraded throughput on dedicated pool 5a; autoscaler oscillating. SRE investigating scheduling / node pressure.

Notes: health designation rules are loose here — Green = on track, Amber = monitor/mitigations required, Red = blocking customer milestone or launch.

2) Deep-dive: Mercury migration failure (primary triage)
- Symptoms: schema migration job (internal migration tool) raised constraint error during canary (table: customer_embeddings_v2). Canary took down inference path for 2 nodes; rollback script executed at 09:44 UTC.
- Root cause hypothesis: migration applied in parallel to active writer instance — tool lacked safe lock for heavy write windows.
- Immediate mitigation taken: rollback + paused staged rollout; metrics alarm created.
- Short-term plan (24–72h):
  - Disable automatic canary promotion for Mercury until migration tool patched (owner: Darren Wu, due 2027-08-13).
  - Run schema migration in maintenance window with DB read-only flag + pre-copy of embeddings table (owner: Priya Shah, due 2027-08-14).
  - Run end-to-end smoke tests against canary with synthetic traffic (owner: Ethan Kim, due 2027-08-14).
- Risks: enterprise launch window likely slips; sales notified (Michael O.). Verify contract SLAs for launch date implications.

3) Alder 500s during EU peak (investigation notes)
- Observed spike correlates with token-heavy prompts (avg seq > 1200 tokens). Serving runtime K/V cache thrashing suspected.
- Initial triage: increased request concurrency -> more cache pressure -> occasional tokenization timeouts surfaced as 500s.
- Temporary mitigation: apply stricter per-route concurrency limit for Alder's prod key (tweak in console, done by Mariana at 2027-08-12 12:05 UTC). Expected to reduce 500s but may increase tail latency.
- Action items:
  - SRE to surface per-node memory and cache eviction logs for 2027-08-11 10:00–14:00 UTC (owner: Toni Alvarez, due 2027-08-13).
  - Solutions engineer to propose a model quantization/seq-splitting suggestion for Alder's team (owner: Lea Martin, due 2027-08-16).

4) Arbour autoscaler oscillation (Dedicated)
- Observed behavior: pool scaled to 6 nodes then quickly down to 3 within 10m, repeatedly. Throughput slippage observed (20% below SLA).
- Hypothesis: autoscaler policy too aggressive on CPU-based metric; GPU memory pressure not considered.
- Short fix: apply conservative cooldown window on autoscaler (owner: Darren Wu, done 2027-08-12 14:30 UTC).
- Longer fix: update autoscaler to consider node-local GPU memory + queue latency metric (ticket: SE-7843 assigned to infra team).

5) Starlight security gating (final sign-off items)
- Customer completed SSO smoke test; outstanding items: audit-log retention policy (customer wants 13 months, default 6 months), KMS integration test pending (HSM certificate rotation flow).
- Action: Coordinate with Security & Compliance for extended retention (owner: Priya Shah), KMS test window scheduled 2027-08-15 (owner: Mariana Lopez).

6) Cross-team coordination & blockers
- SRE: needs a prioritized list of customers with current SLA risk to schedule deeper investigation (provided list: Mercury (R), Alder (A), Arbour (A)).
- Product: asked for a short write-up on expected user-visible degradation tolerance per customer tier — we promised a 1-pager by 2027-08-17 (owner: Michael O.).
- Sales: alerted on Mercury launch delay; potential compensation discussion (pricing teams included).

7) Decisions made in meeting
- Freeze any canary or staged rollout that includes schema migrations until migration tool shows deterministic locks + pre-copy logic (decision by consensus).
- Apply temporary per-key concurrency limits to reduce 500s while sustaining throughput for other keys.

8) Action items (concise list)
- Darren Wu: Patch migration runner to implement table lock + safe retry logic (due 2027-08-13). Linked: PROSERV-212.
- Priya Shah: Prepare DB pre-copy plan and schedule maintenance window with customer Mercury (due 2027-08-14).
- Ethan Kim: Run synthetic smoke tests and publish results (due 2027-08-14).
- Toni Alvarez (SRE): Retrieve node memory/cache eviction logs; check autoscaler interactions (due 2027-08-13).
- Lea Martin: Draft quantization/seq-split playbook for Alder (due 2027-08-16).
- Mariana Lopez: Coordinate KMS test with Starlight and Security on 2027-08-15 (done: calendar invite sent).
- Michael O. (CS): Notify Mercury stakeholders of launch slide and compensation next steps (due 2027-08-13).

9) Open questions / notes to self
- Can we add a simple preflight check to migrations that detects active high-write windows? (action: add to infra backlog SE-7901)
- Consider a short-running, low-cost 'migration staging' mode in Dedicated where write traffic is diverted to a shadow DB for pre-copy — feasibility assessment requested (owner: Darren Wu).
- Need to review SLO/contract language re: migration-caused delays (legal input needed).

10) Followups / next meeting
- Next Healthboard sync: 2027-08-19 11:00 UTC (tentative) — focus: Mercury cutover plan + autoscaler policy update.
- If any Red issues emerge before then, start an ad-hoc triage channel (#se-proservices-triage).

Appendix: quick links and snippets
- Snippet: rollback command used for Mercury canary: `./migration-tool rollback --env mercury-canary --to-tag 2027-08-11_23`
- Quick logs pointer: s3://redwood-logs/proserv/mercury/2027-08-12/ (internal)
- Slack thread: https://slack.redwood.ai/archives/C02SEPROV/p16234567890001234

Raw notes / freeform (notes-to-self style)
- "Customer asked for faster SLA on tail latency — want to assess cost impact of reserving pinned GPU instances per-route. Good to have conservative estimate for next week."
- "Think about adding a regression test that simulates large token prompts (1200+) for Alder-like workloads."
- "Follow up with infra on SE-7843 priority — this one touches Dedicated customers and could reduce noise if fixed."

End of brief.

Prepared by: Mariana Lopez (Solutions Eng Lead)
Status: in_review — please comment inline in Confluence page linked above or add notes in #se-proservices-triage.
